title: Declare coverage exceptions only through config allow-lists or draft status

facts.note: Plan artifacts (trains, wagons, features, WMBTs, acceptances) and coverage config are identifiable by path.
Plan artifact and config locations; exact globs depend on repository layout.
Task wording signalling an intended coverage gap.
Requires coverage-detector output to know a gap exists that must either be closed or excepted.

values: artifact status set to or from draft
facts.note: Diff-level observer on config and artifact status fields.

fires: Planner adds a utility/shared/under-development wagon that is intentionally not placed in any train.
Planner keeps a deprecated or experimental feature that no wagon/WMBT references.
Planner authors a draft or placeholder WMBT that has no acceptance yet.
A coverage check reports a gap and the planner intends to exempt rather than close it.
doesNotFire: Planner adds a wagon to a train, or a WMBT with full acceptance coverage — no exception is needed.
Code-only changes that touch no plan artifact or coverage config.

given: A plan artifact (wagon, feature or WMBT) intentionally does not satisfy full coverage
when: the planner records that coverage gap
then: Declare the exception only through the matching coverage.exceptions.* config allow-list entry or by marking the artifact status: draft — never leave the gap undeclared.
prefer: List wagons that are utility, shared or under development in coverage.exceptions.wagons_not_in_train.
List deprecated or experimental features in coverage.exceptions.features_orphaned.
Mark genuinely unfinished artifacts status: draft; draft status exempts them from full coverage (COVERAGE-PLAN-2.1 and COVERAGE-PLAN-2.4) only.
avoid: Leaving a coverage gap with no allow-list entry or draft status.
Allow-listing an artifact in a list whose use case does not fit it (e.g. putting a finished, live wagon in wagons_not_in_train).
Marking finished artifacts draft just to silence coverage checks, or assuming draft exempts from checks other than COVERAGE-PLAN-2.1 and 2.4.
why: Coverage checks are strict; explicit, config-recorded exceptions keep intentional gaps visible and reviewable instead of hiding real missing coverage.
evidence: Every coverage gap reported by the detector maps to an entry under the matching coverage.exceptions.* key or to an artifact with status: draft.
Draft exemptions are only applied to COVERAGE-PLAN-2.1 and COVERAGE-PLAN-2.4 findings.
Each allow-list entry fits its list's use case (utility/shared/under-development wagons; deprecated/experimental features; draft/placeholder WMBTs).
verifier_detail: Allow-list = config path + use case: coverage.exceptions.wagons_not_in_train (utility/shared/under-development wagons); coverage.exceptions.features_orphaned (deprecated/experimental features); coverage.exceptions.wmbts_without_acceptance (draft/placeholder WMBTs).
Status exemption: artifacts with status draft are exempt from full coverage, specifically draft_exempt_from = [COVERAGE-PLAN-2.1, COVERAGE-PLAN-2.4]; other coverage checks still apply.
audit: Original statement: Coverage exceptions are declared via config allow-lists and status exemptions (draft artifacts are exempt from 2.1 and 2.4).
